auditMetadata.auditType: Systems Review - Authentication, Cart, Checkout, Products
auditMetadata.summary: Core e-commerce systems are partially implemented with several critical inconsistencies requiring attention

authentication.description: Two separate authentication systems exist causing confusion and potential security issues

pages/auth.tsx.description: Main auth page with Supabase integration
features: Email/password sign in and sign up

hooks/useAuth.ts.description: React hook for auth state management
features: useAuth() - provides user, loading, error states

pages/account/login.tsx.description: Customer login page using localStorage sessions - NOT Supabase auth
features: Social login buttons (Google, Apple - not implemented)
issues: CRITICAL: Uses localStorage for sessions instead of Supabase auth
Social login shows 'coming soon' toast only
Separate from main /auth page causing dual auth systems

pages/account/signup.tsx.description: Customer signup page - localStorage only, no actual registration
issues: CRITICAL: Does NOT create users in Supabase - only localStorage
No email verification
Social signup shows 'coming soon' toast only
No actual email sending - just stores token
Queries 'customers' table, not 'profiles'

pages/account/reset-password.tsx.description: Password reset form with token validation
features: Marks token as used after reset
issues: Updates 'customers' table, not synced with Supabase auth

criticalIssues.description: pages/auth.tsx uses Supabase auth properly, while pages/account/login.tsx and signup.tsx use localStorage-based sessions. Users registered via /account/signup are NOT created in Supabase.
criticalIssues.impact: Users created via /account/signup cannot access features requiring Supabase auth
criticalIssues.recommendation: Unify to single Supabase-based auth system

criticalIssues.description: Google and Apple login buttons exist but only show 'coming soon' toast
criticalIssues.recommendation: Either implement OAuth or remove buttons

criticalIssues.description: forgot-password and reset-password pages use 'customers' table, not 'profiles' table
criticalIssues.impact: Password reset may not work for all users
criticalIssues.recommendation: Align with Supabase auth or ensure customers table syncs

recommendations: Or migrate /account pages to use Supabase auth like /auth does
Implement actual email sending for password reset using Resend integration
Implement Google/Apple OAuth or remove buttons

shoppingCart.description: Cart system is well-implemented with localStorage fallback for guests and Supabase sync for authenticated users

hooks/useCart.ts.description: Cart hook with dual storage strategy
features: Authenticated cart via Supabase cart_items table
issues: Guest cart does not merge with user cart on login

features: Price display per item and total
Checkout button with auth redirect for guests

recommendations: Consider merging guest cart with user cart on login
Add cart persistence timeout for guests

checkout.description: Checkout flow uses Stripe integration with proper session creation

issues: No guest checkout option

lib/stripeClient.ts.description: Stripe client configuration using Replit connectors
features: Dynamic credential fetching from Replit connectors

issues: Images use protocol://domain prefix - may fail for some product images
Does not fetch order details from Stripe
Very basic - may be legacy

pages/checkout/success.tsx.description: Detailed success page with order details
features: Fetches order details from Stripe session
Links to orders and continue shopping

recommendations: Add webhook handling for order fulfillment
Add order creation in database on successful payment

products.description: Product display works but relies heavily on hardcoded data instead of API

pages/products.tsx.description: Products listing page with category filter
issues: Requires auth to add to cart (redirects)

pages/shop-all.tsx.description: Shop all page with fallback products
features: Product cards with Add to Cart
issues: CRITICAL: Uses hardcoded fallbackProducts array
Does NOT fetch from API/database
Product data is static

pages/products/[id].tsx.description: Product detail page with comprehensive UI
issues: CRITICAL: Uses hardcoded PRODUCT_DATA object
Does NOT fetch from API/database
Product data is static and must be updated in code
Very large file (500+ lines of product data)
Well-implemented but NOT USED by product pages
Product pages use hardcoded data instead

criticalIssues.description: pages/products/[id].tsx and pages/shop-all.tsx use hardcoded product data instead of fetching from Supabase via lib/api/products.ts
criticalIssues.impact: Product updates require code changes and deployments. Database products not displayed.
criticalIssues.recommendation: Migrate product pages to use lib/api/products.ts functions

criticalIssues.description: lib/api/products.ts has comprehensive API functions that are not used by frontend pages
criticalIssues.recommendation: Integrate API functions into product pages

recommendations: Migrate pages/products/[id].tsx to fetch from getProductById()
Migrate pages/shop-all.tsx to fetch from getAllProducts()
Move hardcoded product data to Supabase products table
Add product image URLs to database
Implement proper product caching with ISR or SWR

crossSystemIssues.description: The dual auth systems mean cart behavior differs between /auth and /account/login users
crossSystemIssues.recommendation: Unify authentication to single Supabase-based system

crossSystemIssues.description: Products use hardcoded data while cart uses Supabase, causing potential product_id mismatches
crossSystemIssues.recommendation: Ensure all product IDs align between hardcoded data and database

prioritizedRecommendations.description: Remove or migrate pages/account/login.tsx and signup.tsx to use Supabase auth like pages/auth.tsx
Update pages/products/[id].tsx and pages/shop-all.tsx to fetch from Supabase using lib/api/products.ts
Use Resend integration to send actual password reset emails
Create webhook to handle successful payments and create orders in database
Merge guest localStorage cart with user cart when logging in
Either implement Google/Apple OAuth or remove misleading buttons
prioritizedRecommendations.estimatedEffort: High if implementing, Low if removing

keyFindings: Shopping cart and checkout systems are well-implemented and functional
Authentication has critical dual-system issue requiring immediate attention
Products system bypasses API layer with hardcoded data
Stripe integration is properly configured using Replit connectors
conclusion.recommendation: Focus on unifying authentication and migrating products to database before adding new features
